visuals.caption: A circle with pentagon ABCDE and its diagonals, and arc AB marked 100°.
Arcs FD and CA are marked equal; 30° is at E and (5x − 40)° is at B.
Parallel chords BA and DC, with (3y − 5)° at E and arc AC marked 50°.
Equal chords AD and BE meet when extended at C outside the circle.
Equal chords AB and CD cross at E, with DE and EB marked equal and AC joined.
Chords AB and AC are marked equal, with E on the circle joined to A, B and C.
Quadrilateral ABCD with both diagonals, and the angles at C and D on base AB marked equal.
Quadrilateral ABCD with both diagonals, AB = AD, angle C = 50° and angle A = 80°.
Trapezium ABCD with AD parallel to BC, diagonals meeting at E, angle DEC = 76° and angle CBD = 38°.
Quadrilateral ABCD with diagonals meeting at E, angle D = 60°, angle AEB = 85°, angle B = 25°, DA and CD marked equal in the way shown.
Inscribed angles C, D and E all stand on the same arc AB.
Trapezium ABCD with AD parallel to BC, diagonals meeting at E, and EC and EB marked equal.
Rectangle ABCD with a right angle at every corner.
Square ABCD with right angles at the corners and two equal sides marked.
Parallelogram ABCD with both pairs of opposite sides marked parallel.
A circle with points A, B, C, D; 50° is marked at A and 25° at D.
A circle with points A, B, C, D; chords AD and AB are marked equal, with 70° at D and 20° at B.
Lines from outside point A cut the circle at D, E and B, C; 43° is marked at A and 20° at C.
Chords AB and CD cross at E with EA and ED marked equal; DA and BC are joined.
Two circles N and M meet at A and B, with lines through A joining D, C and F, E and chords to B.
Circle M with chords EF, ED, BA and BC making inscribed angles at E and B.
Two circles N and M, each with an inscribed angle: E in circle N and B in circle M.
